meta.source: Decisions page 24 Oct 2026 + songnodes repo audit + Naarm Set Builder

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (Elektronauts charcoal in dark). Everything sits on it.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Panels, neutral cards, table body, drawer, dialog.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised parts inside a surface-1 panel: table header, hovered row, segmented-control track.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Pressed/selected neutral fills, progress tracks, skeleton shimmer base.

tokens.name: sunk
tokens.usage: Inputs, code wells, the transition strip between set rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers and hairlines between rows and sections. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, chips, checkboxes). Holds 3:1 on bg, surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface-1, surface-2 and surface-3.

tokens.name: fg-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata lines, table cells that support the main column. 4.5:1 on bg, surface-1, surface-2.

tokens.name: fg-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: the dimmed lead-in of a thin–bold title, captions, column headers. 4.5:1 on bg and surface-1.

tokens.name: fg-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only (exempt from contrast). Pair with not-allowed cursor and aria-disabled.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind drawers and dialogs.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: SongNodes itself: wordmark, the one primary button per view, focus ring, selection outline, the generic link colour where no module applies. Never a status.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills and brand text.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row / selected chip background, current item in the drawer.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill (primary button).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Generic text link colour where a link leads nowhere module-specific (help, external sites). Dark uses brand-strong so it holds 4.5:1 on surface-1 and surface-2. Always underlined.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element. Brand lavender holds 3:1 on every surface in every theme.

tokens.name: hover-bg
tokens.usage: Hover wash on rows, menu items and quiet buttons.

tokens.name: flag-bg
tokens.usage: Background for a row or cell flagged for attention (needs an energy check, duplicate, stale). The only tint used for flagging; pair with a warn marker.

tokens.name: mod-graph
tokens.usage: Graph identity: its menu icon, any text link leading to Graph, chart marks that mean 'Graph'. Explore the track graph: nodes, edges, neighbourhoods. Reads 4.5:1 on bg and surface-1.

tokens.name: mod-graph-bg
tokens.usage: Tonal card fill for Graph cards and the Graph page header band.

tokens.name: mod-graph-raised
tokens.usage: Chips, inner wells and secondary buttons inside a Graph tonal card.

tokens.name: mod-graph-line
tokens.usage: Border of a Graph tonal card and dividers inside it.

tokens.name: mod-graph-ink
tokens.usage: Titles and primary text inside a Graph tonal card (on mod-graph-bg and mod-graph-raised).

tokens.name: mod-graph-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text inside a Graph tonal card.

tokens.name: on-mod-graph
tokens.usage: Text on a solid Graph fill (a Graph action button inside its own page, the module chip in the drawer).

tokens.name: mod-library

tokens.name: mod-library-bg

tokens.name: mod-library-raised

tokens.name: mod-library-line

tokens.name: mod-library-ink

tokens.name: mod-library-muted

tokens.name: on-mod-library
tokens.usage: Text on a solid Library fill (a Library action button inside its own page, the module chip in the drawer).

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Healthy / passed / perfect transition. Always with the ● glyph or the word. Text/icon colour, 4.5:1 on bg, surface-1 and its own -bg.

tokens.name: status-ok-bg
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind a ok banner, pill or cell.

tokens.name: status-fair
tokens.usage: Acceptable but not ideal: compatible transition, degraded-but-working. With the ◐ glyph. Text/icon colour, 4.5:1 on bg, surface-1 and its own -bg.

tokens.name: status-fair-bg
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind a fair banner, pill or cell.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: Needs a look: stale data, retrying, needs a check. With the ▲ glyph (compat-possible uses ○). Text/icon colour, 4.5:1 on bg, surface-1 and its own -bg.

tokens.name: status-warn-bg
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind a warn banner, pill or cell.

tokens.name: status-bad
tokens.usage: Failed / clash / error. With the ✕ glyph. Traffic light in every theme, so the glyph and word are what make it readable without colour. Text/icon colour, 4.5:1 on bg, surface-1 and its own -bg.

tokens.name: status-bad-bg
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind a bad banner, pill or cell.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Neutral information. Deliberately grey: blue belongs to the Graph module. Text/icon colour, 4.5:1 on bg, surface-1 and its own -bg.

tokens.name: status-info-bg
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind a info banner, pill or cell.

tokens.name: on-status-bad
tokens.usage: Text on a solid bad fill: the destructive button.

tokens.name: compat-perfect
tokens.usage: Transition / harmonic compatibility: perfect (same key, relative major/minor). Glyph ●.

tokens.name: compat-compatible
tokens.usage: Compatible (±1 on the Camelot wheel). Glyph ◐.

tokens.name: compat-possible
tokens.usage: Possible with care (+2 energy boost, +7 lift, BPM gap 5–8). Glyph ○.

tokens.name: compat-clash
tokens.usage: Clash (any other key move, BPM gap > 8, energy jump ≥ +2). Glyph ✕.

tokens.name: progress-fill
tokens.usage: Completion bars and rings. Completion is not health, so it is neutral; a health judgement colours the label, never the bar.

tokens.name: progress-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled part of progress bars and rings.

tokens.name: energy-1
tokens.usage: Energy 1 of 10 (Low tier). Fill of the energy bar segments and the set wave bars. A mark, never text: the number is always printed beside it.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and the tier band behind the energy wave.

tokens.name: chart-axis
tokens.usage: Axis labels and tick text.

tokens.name: chart-ref
tokens.usage: Reference and target lines (target wave, average, threshold): 1.5px dashed 5 4.

tokens.name: on-now
tokens.usage: Text on a solid now fill (the small "Now" tag).

tokens.name: now
tokens.usage: The marker for 'now' (choice "now-marker: c"): the playing track, the current slot, today's column, the current time on a timeline. Amber, so it never reads as 'selected' (brand lavender). A mark (3:1), not body text.

tokens.name: sim
tokens.usage: Simulated or hypothetical data (a proposed set, a preview of a rebuild): hatched with this colour and labelled 'Preview'.

tokens.name: svc-spotify
tokens.usage: Spotify's own green: only on the 'Connect Spotify' button and Spotify source badge, per Spotify's brand rules.

tokens.name: on-svc-spotify
tokens.usage: Text on svc-spotify.

tokens.name: svc-tidal
tokens.usage: TIDAL's black: only on the 'Connect TIDAL' button (with a 1px white border on dark grounds).

tokens.name: on-svc-tidal
tokens.usage: Text on svc-tidal.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Cover and launcher home title only.

styles.name: title-l
styles.usage: Page title (the bold half of the thin–bold title). One per page.

styles.name: title-m
styles.usage: Section headings inside a page; dialog titles.

styles.name: title-s
styles.usage: Card titles, drawer group titles, track title in detail views.

styles.name: title-lead
styles.usage: The lead-in of a thin–bold title: same size as the title it precedes, weight 400, colour fg-3 (or mod-*-muted inside a tonal card). Ends with a colon.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Headline figures in figure tiles; tabular numerals.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Energy climbs one point at a time, then drops two or three after a peak.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ross From Friends – Talk To Me You'll Drown
styles.usage: Default UI and table text (15px, Elektronauts' size).

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Track titles in rows, button labels, link text.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Meta lines under titles, helper text under fields, toasts.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Column headers, rail group titles, eyebrow labels. Uppercase via CSS only, never typed in caps; keep to 3 words.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Freshness stamps, chart notes, method text.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: BPM, keys, durations, counts and IDs in rows. Tabular by nature.

styles.name: data-strong
styles.usage: Emphasised data: the transition verdict, the current value.

styles.name: data-s
styles.usage: External IDs (ISRC, Spotify ID), chart tick labels.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: No gap.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Hairline nudges: energy segment gap, icon-to-badge.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight: chip padding block, icon-to-label in dense rows.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Default gap inside controls and between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between form fields in a row; table cell inline padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact), page side gutter minimum, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (default).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page; drawer padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page regions (rail and content).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Space above a section heading.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page top padding below the header on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Cover and empty-state breathing room.

spacing.note: 4px base. Use gap on flex/grid, never margins between siblings.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, pills with text, energy segments (2px inside bars), key badges.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, segmented controls, menu items, tooltips, table containers.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards (tonal and neutral), launcher tiles, figure tiles, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Drawers' inner edge, dialogs, media viewer: the biggest objects.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, the toggle switch, progress bars, avatars of services.

radius.note: Three-step shape scale: the rounder, the bigger and more 'object' it is.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards (Ghost style): barely there; the border does the work.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, tooltips, the sticky header once scrolled.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Drawers and dialogs above the scrim.

shadow.note: Depth means 'floats above the page'. Cards rest at shadow-1; only floating layers get more.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and inputs in dense toolbars and table rows.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button, input and select height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Large buttons: empty-state actions, booth mode, touch-first screens.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for anything tappable on phone and tablet (pad small visuals to reach it).

tokens.name: row-compact
tokens.usage: Table row height in compact density.

tokens.name: row-comfortable
tokens.usage: Table row height, default density.

tokens.name: row-two-line
tokens.usage: Two-line rows (title + meta) in lists and the running order.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: App header height.

tokens.name: drawer-w
tokens.usage: Navigation drawer width (max 86vw on phones).

tokens.name: rail-w
tokens.usage: Filter rail width on desktop.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max content width; wider screens centre it.

tokens.name: prose-max
tokens.usage: Max line length for running text and help.

tokens.name: z-base
tokens.usage: Page content.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table headers, sticky filter rail.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: App header.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: Navigation drawer and side sheets.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the media viewer.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, context menu, select lists.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Reduced motion: every duration collapses to this.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, focus, chip toggle.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Drawer, dialog, disclosure, tab indicator.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Chart transitions and graph camera moves (max).

duration.note: Reduced motion sets every duration to 0ms except progress indication.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Everything that moves in or changes size.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Elements leaving (drawer close, toast out).

tokens.name: bp-phone
tokens.usage: Below: one column, drawer navigation, tables become cards or scroll in their box.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Tablet: rails collapse to a Filters button; two-column cards.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: Desktop: filter rail + content; side panels open beside, not over.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: Wide: three-region layouts (library, graph, panel).

tokens.name: bp-wall
tokens.usage: Wall/kiosk: booth theme recommended, type scale steps up one size.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls (with aria-disabled).

tokens.name: opacity-faded
tokens.usage: Graph nodes and edges outside the current selection or filter.

tokens.name: opacity-edge
tokens.usage: Default graph edge opacity; strong edges 0.9.
